scope: Targeted physical/Jacobian prerequisites for offline sensitivity; no estimator, old test suite, saved Cell B coordinates or primary protocol execution.
reference: Unchanged src/scm_model.c:scm_physical_step, compiled as a strict C99 shared library and invoked through ctypes once per physical interval, plus independently written single-dwell formulas and central differences.

sampling.t0: Initial state and voltage at the first segment current, without physical time advancement.
sampling.observations: End of each carried constant-current sample interval; no duplicate boundary row.

checks: Eight public fixture trajectories versus production C voltage, SOC, three RC states and hysteresis.
All 16 voltage/SOC Jacobian columns versus central finite differences on every fixture sample.
Independent constant-dwell formulas for physical trajectories and all Jacobian columns, including entering-state derivatives.
Discharge/charge signs for log tau, active log gamma and log Q; inactive gamma is zero; hysteresis remains fixed at rest.
Equivalent constant dwell split into three pieces preserves physical path and Jacobians.
No input mutation; Jacobian-request flag preserves the physical trajectory.
Nonfinite coordinates, negative R0/H, initial SOC/h outside domain and a propagated SOC domain exit must raise ValueError.
stop: One targeted prerequisite execution; if a concrete implementation or checker error occurs, preserve its first attempt and record the fix before one affected-scope recheck. No long protocol, estimator or old-study replay.
limits: Finite host floating-point fixtures validate these implemented paths, not global identifiability, uncertainty coverage or indefinite operation.
The production physical reference and direct formulas use the repository's known illustrative OCV curve and matched model; this is not a hardware or model-mismatch qualification.
